system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Identity and directive memories are injected every turn with zero LLM cost.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled from GENOME.md/MEMORY.md, canonical facts ledger, hormonal dimensions; dream 'Harness Evolution' mode evolves prompt fragments.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Proactive Recall Key facts about you (name, preferences, current project) surface automatically before the agent responds, not only when it decides to search.
env_context_strategy.note: Auto-injected memory context plus tools (browser, code, memory_search) for navigation.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Compression Merges redundant memories into denser, token-efficient representations
context_compaction.note: Redaction/truncation of tool summaries noted in logging; summarization via dream compression and Deep Recall for huge contexts.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Dedicated Chromium browser control, Python/JS code execution, and Canvas visual workspace with A2UI rendering.
observation_format.note: Evidence does not show image content blocks explicitly; text observations assumed.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Agent-native: built for coding agents with tool use, sessions, memory, and multi-agent routing
tool_call_format.note: Tool-call mechanism not shown in evidence; inferred from tool call panels/`tool.call_id` spans.

edit_primitive.note: A str_replace tool view exists; other edit primitives not evidenced.

tool_schema_source.note: MCP server shipped in benchmarks; schema authoring style not directly shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: **[ACP](src/acp/)**: Agent Client Protocol server for IDE and external agent connections.
protocol_standardization.note: A2A Agent2Agent v1.0.0, ACP, x402; MCP server under benchmarks.

loop_primitives.note: Gateway is event/RPC driven; long-horizon work-rest-dream cycles; `run.attempt`: run retry/attempt metadata.

planning_granularity.note: Cowork task tree suggests a stored task structure; not directly documented.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Bitterbot - a mesh of agents that turns shared experience into collective capability.
multi_agent_topology.note: Single local agent per node, but P2P/A2A peers and Circles exchange as equals; multi-agent routing per session.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: publishes it to a decentralized network via Gossipsub
delegation_mechanism.note: External agents delegate tasks via A2A JSON-RPC; gossip bus for skills.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Every agent-initiated write queues for your approval first.
human_in_loop.note: DM pairing approval; Active Guards one-click promotion; circles.enabled toggle.

short_term_state.note: Sessions carry state plus hormonal/GCCRF live state read by interceptors.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **`MEMORY.md`** Living working memory, rewritten every dream cycle.
long_term_memory.note: Memory crystals DB + embeddings, knowledge graph, P2P skills marketplace/skill library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Isolated sessions per agent, workspace, or sender.
state_persistence.note: Persistent sessions and SQLite persistence imply reload across restarts; no explicit resume code cited.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Each cycle is scored by a **Dream Quality Score** that measures crystal yield, merge efficiency, orphan rescue, Bond stability, and token efficiency
self_verification.note: Harness Evolution is gated by a validation gate; skills gated by 3+ executions, >70% success rate; benchmarks include an LLM judge.

retry_policy.note: Retries are recorded; policy details not evidenced.

rollback.note: No file/repo rollback mechanism evidenced; only ledger reversals.

termination_condition.note: CompleteToolView suggests a completion tool; explicit step/cost caps not evidenced.

cost_controls.note: Cost/token counters (`bitterbot.cost.usd`, cache_read/cache_write tokens) and Deep Recall result caching (1h TTL).

timeouts.note: Timeouts not explicitly documented in evidence; low confidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Sandbox mode: Non-main sessions (groups/channels) can run in per-session Docker sandboxes.
execution_isolation.note: Default main session runs locally on the host (local-first); Docker sandbox for non-main sessions.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: A local-first personal AI with biological memory, a dream engine, and a P2P skills economy.
filesystem_access.note: Workspace files panel and local execution imply full host access within the boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: browses the web, runs code, talks to you on WhatsApp
network_policy.note: No egress allowlist documented; P2P and web access open.

permission_model.evidence_quote: read the agent's live hormonal + GCCRF state, and rewrite, inject context into, require prerequisites for, or block any tool call before it executes
permission_model.note: Pre-action interceptors; plus allowlists (allowFrom) and DM pairing.

tracing.evidence_quote: Bitterbot emits OpenTelemetry traces from the gateway, agent runtime, memory subsystem, and long-horizon runner.
tracing.note: Disabled unless a collector endpoint is set; JSONL file logs on by default.

replayability.evidence_quote: **Replay** | Strengthens high-importance memory pathways (no LLM cost)
replayability.note: Sessions persist and events are logged, but no trajectory replay runner evidenced; dream 'Replay' is memory replay, not trace replay.

eval_hooks.note: benchmarks/ ships ARC-AGI-3, LongMemEval, BioMemEval, dream-ablation runners.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Inbound text is injection-scanned on receipt and stored wrapped in a `circle_agent` content class.
guardrails.note: Redaction of sensitive tokens in console output; interceptors block tool calls.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Bitterbot is a **self-hosted gateway** that connects your favorite chat apps
target_domain.note: Personal assistant: browser control, code execution, coding agents; also chat channels.
